pages.title: PERT — single genome-editing strategy for many disorders

facts.text: Journal: Nature; by Broad Institute, Harvard, University of Minnesota
facts.head: Study

facts.text: PERT: Prime-Editing-mediated Readthrough of Premature Termination codons — edits a tRNA gene into a suppressor tRNA
facts.head: Study

facts.text: Target: nonsense mutations (premature stop codon, e.g. TAG) — ~25% of disease-causing genetic changes
facts.head: Study

facts.text: Human cells have 418 tRNA genes; 4 promising — leucine, arginine, tyrosine, serine
facts.head: Key numbers

facts.text: 17,000+ configurations tested; enzyme PE6c + PE3 strategy
facts.head: Key numbers

facts.text: Efficiency: 60–80% vs HDR 10–20%
facts.head: Key numbers

facts.text: Mouse models: Batten, Tay-Sachs, Niemann-Pick C1; Hurler syndrome — activity restored to 1.7% of normal
